title: Compile open ride-acceleration datasets with provenance
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Design load cases rest on a few published figures. Openly licensed measured traces (papers' supplementary data, physics-education datasets, open smartphone recordings) would let the arrest model use real pulses.
objective: Collect openly licensed, measured ride acceleration time series, normalise them to a common CSV schema (time s; ax, ay, az in g; ride-frame axes documented) and write a datasheet for each.
acceptanceCriteria: Only data whose licence allows redistribution; licence and source recorded per file
Schema documented; datasheet per file (ride type, sensor, sample rate, mounting, axes, known issues)
Summary table of peak -Gz and pulse duration per dataset
